name: Sauerkraut Salad
description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Freezer Cole Slaw
_similar.description: A freezer coleslaw recipe with a sweet and tangy dressing, made with grated cabbage and optional vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat together vinegar, sugar, salt, water, celery seed, and mustard to make the syrup.
Grate or chop cabbage and other vegetables in a food processor.
Cover the cabbage mixture with the syrup and refrigerate overnight.
Place in a container, seal, and freeze.

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Macaroni Salad
_similar.description: A classic macaroni salad with tuna, ham, and cheddar cheese, mixed with Miracle Whip and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Let cool.
Cut up celery, cheese, tuna, and ham into small pieces.
Combine cooled macaroni with the tuna mixture.
Add enough Miracle Whip to moisten the salad.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and paprika.
Mix well and serve.

_similar.keywords: macaroni salad, tuna salad, cheddar cheese
